title: Speaking — Choosing a course
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on choosing a course.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
How do you decide whether a course is worth taking?
Do you prefer courses with practical exercises?

part2.topic: Describe a course or workshop you were glad to attend.
points: where you found out about it
part2.closing: and explain what made it worth your time.

questions: What information should course providers give prospective students?
How can employers support workers who want to retrain?
How has everyday life connected with choosing a course changed for people of different ages?
